summary: Aflac Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a cybersecurity incident at its Japanese subsidiary, Aflac Life Insurance Japan Ltd. An unauthorized third-party accessed certain systems between June 15-25, 2026, compromising policy details, personal information, and bank account data. The company has contained the breach, engaged third-party experts, notified regulators, and will notify affected individuals. No special-situation transaction (merger, tender, spin-off, activist campaign, etc.) is involved; the filing is a routine current report on an operational incident.
